vo01.text: Real recordings are messy: retakes, false starts, breaths, long pauses.

vo04.text: Drop in a recording, pick a model — it can run locally, right on your computer — and press Voice Cut.

vo05.text: It transcribes everything you said, reads it like an editor, and keeps the best take of every line.

vo06.text: It cuts only in the silence between words, and turns breaths into your own room tone.

vo09.text: VoiceCut is free and open source. Run it on your own computer, or with your own key for OpenRouter, Gemini, OpenAI or DeepSeek.

vo10.text: Record with all your retakes. Get back one clean take.
